George, saw Collectly acquired Pledge Health and partnered with Sunbit this spring.

Expanding the platform that fast usually opens more in-market provider accounts than the team can cover before quota catches up, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Collectly off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

George, quick follow-up for Collectly.

With an acquisition and a new partnership live, the number climbs faster than headcount can. Most VPs of sales don't actually know how many booked meetings it takes to hit the target, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Collectly needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

George, last bit of proof for Collectly.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Collectly's reply rate likely compares to other healthtech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
